name: Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum - Rum - 750 ML - Spiced Rum
description: Get your next rum fix from one the most trusted names in the business by picking up this bottle of the premium Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum. Introduced in 1944 by the Seagram Company, the Captain Morgan brand of rum is named in honor of Welsh privateer of Sir Henry Morgan who later became Lieutenant Governor of Jamaica where the rum was produced. Known for distilling their expressions from fermented sugar cane rather than molasses, their proprietary recipe also involves the addition of Caribbean spices giving their rums their distinctive flavor profile. A lavish offering worthy of having a place in the Captains Quarters, each batch of Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum begins with a selection of rums "plundered" from their reserves and carefully blended to achieve the optimal level of flavor and smoothness. The resulting blend is then infused with a secret blend of spices to further enhance its flavor before being brought to proof with pure water and finally bottled. Bright mahogany in color, each sip of this rum greets its drinkers with an inviting nose of molasses, vanilla, pepper, cinnamon, clove, and nutmeg which is then immediately followed by a rich and complex palate of coconut, tropical fruits, butterscotch, more vanilla, baking spices, and roasted coffee, culminating in a clean and smooth finish of Demerara sugar and toffee notes. Great for both sipping and mixing, the Captain Morgan Private Stock Rum is the perfect pick up for those who like their rum on the sweet side. So dont wait and get yourself a bottle today and indulge yourself in the flavors of the Captains treasured stash. Blend of reserve rums matured for at least 2 years Aged in ex-bourbon American oak barrels Great for sipping and cocktails

name: Hyde 10 Year Old Nr.1 President's Cask Sherry Finish Irish Whiskey
description: Hibernia Distillers was founded in 2014 by Conor and Alan Hyde in Skibbereen, Ireland. The brothers reached meteoric success with their traditional single malt and single grain Irish whiskeys earning themselves a strong reputation for producing high quality, award-winning Irish spirit. Hyde Single Malt Irish whiskey is crafted from 100% malted Irish barley, and made in small batches using a traditional copper pot still. The whiskey is then matured for over ten years in flame-charred, first fill, ex-bourbon casks sourced from Kentucky before being finished for an additional six months in either a Sherry or Oak casks.Two separate casks are used to age their sherry finished whiskey. For the first decade, Hyde single malt is aged in flame-charred, first fill, 200-liter oak bourbon barrels. The whiskey is then transferred into toasted Oloroso sherry casks, for an additional ten months. These casks are 250-liter Hogshead barrels crafted from white oak and sourced from Cadiz in the Andalusia region of South West Spain.The flamed bourbon casks initially add sweeter vanilla and caramel flavor, followed by the toasted sherry casks which add a nutty, spice, dried fruit, and toffee character to the final dram (producer). This inspiring Irish whiskey won a double gold medal and Best Single Malt Irish Whiskey at the 2016 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.Pick up your bottle today!
